summary: P0 'FEED UNAVAILABLE' fix verified end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 pytest green including new /api/market-chart P0 suite — Coinbase-first crypto returns status:'ok' with non-empty prices for bitcoin/ethereum/solana and long-tail dogecoin/cardano/ripple/litecoin/polkadot (with & without ?symbol=). Unknown coin (id=notarealcoinxyz) returns HTTP 200 {status:'unavailable', prices:[]} — never 502. Stock charts (AAPL, ^GSPC × days=1/7/30) return ok. /api/market-prices returns full 11-symbol set (BTC,ETH,SOL,SPX,IXIC,DJI,AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,TSLA,AMZN). WebSocket snapshot+ping/pong still green. Board chart view rapid-click ETH→SOL→AAPL→NVDA→BTC settles on market-chart-bitcoin (no stale winner, no duplicate). Rapid timeframe toggle on BTC ends on the last-clicked timeframe with a populated SVG. Ticker status shows 'LIVE · US MARKETS CLOSED' (correct for test time). Quick chips (bitcoin/ethereum/spx) each open a populated chart. All 7 routes render (body_len ≥ 1959). perf-monitor gating correct (absent normally, present with ?perf=1 showing FEED LIVE). Zero uncaught console errors / pageerrors. Mobile 390px /markets and / have no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: Query 'ripple' does not surface the CoinGecko id=ripple crypto — returns only stock ETPs (ARXRP.SW, ECXRP.AS, 21Shares Ripple ETPs). Users must type 'xrp' to reach the ripple crypto. Search relevance issue only; the /api/market-chart?id=ripple endpoint itself works (returns 168 points). Consider indexing common asset names as aliases.

New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_market_chart_p0.py covers Coinbase-first crypto (common + long-tail), unknown-coin never-502 contract, and stock chart timeframes. rca of the issue: N/A — no new critical bugs. The only nit (ripple search) is a symbol-aliasing gap in /api/market-search: it appears to match against stock names first and doesn't fall back to CoinGecko id/name aliases for the query 'ripple'. Reproduction: curl '/api/market-search?q=ripple' returns 4 stock ETPs and zero crypto entries; curl '/api/market-search?q=xrp' correctly returns id=ripple,symbol=XRP,type=crypto,rank=4. Mitigation: extend the crypto search index with common natural-language names (e.g. 'ripple' -> XRP, 'ether' -> ETH) or query CoinGecko /search as a fallback when zero crypto results are found.
